references.text: Isaiah describes a situation where thorns grow up instead of fruit, which resembles the image Jesus paints of the seed falling among thorns and bearing no fruit.
Jeremiah uses the image of thorns being choked by other plants, which can be seen as parallel to how thorns choke the seed in Jesus' parable.
In Matthew's version of the Parable of the Sower, it is also described how some seeds fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked them.
Luke gives a similar description to Mark and Matthew in his version of the Parable of the Sower, where the seeds fall among thorns that choke the plants.
